Lenses: `2B.1`, `2B.3`, `2B.7`, `2B.10`. [Myanmar embassy record](https://myanmarembassykl.org/press-release-of-informal-discussion-on-myanmar-18-19-june-2023-thailand/)

Lenses: `2B.3`, `2B.6`, `2B.7`. [ASEAN communiqué](https://asean.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/The-56th-AMM-Joint-Communique.pdf)

Lenses: `5B.6`, `5B.7`, `5B.9`, `5B.10`. [BOT fourth-quarter release](https://www.bot.or.th/en/news-and-media/news/news-20240131.html)

Lenses: `6B.2`, `6B.3`, `6B.7`, `6B.8`, `6B.10`. [ILO policy review](https://www.ilo.org/publications/policy-review-social-security-domestic-workers-thailand)
